verdict.rationale: Godot officially supports building against its object-oriented API in GDScript, C# on the modern .NET runtime, and C++ via GDExtension, and documents each first-party (godot-docs-1, godot-docs-2, godot-docs-8, godot-docs-24, godot-docs-26). The project also ships a keyless Asset Library JSON API and a built-in GDScript language server with an official VS Code client. Community reports say C# is a second-class citizen with fewer examples and no web export, and that third-party bindings are immature. Missing for 10: C# parity with GDScript (fewer examples, no web export), in-depth evidence on the GDExtension C++ SDK, and mature bindings beyond GDScript and C#.
